---
title: "Download MSMS"
---

The current release is **MSMS 2.6.2** (November 2026). It fixes crashes on large or unusual
inputs, merges duplicate atoms instead of stopping, and runs `-all_components` in parallel. For
inputs that 2.6.1 handled, the output is unchanged. See the [release notes](release-notes.qmd).

MSMS is free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a license (see [License](license.qmd)).

| Platform | Version | File | Unpack with |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linux 64-bit | 2.6.2 | [Linux 64-bit tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.2/msms_i86_64Linux2_2.6.2.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_i86_64Linux2_2.6.2.tar.gz` |
| macOS 10.15 and later, Apple silicon and Intel | 2.6.2 | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.2/msms_universalDarwin_2.6.2.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_universalDarwin_2.6.2.tar.gz` |
| Windows 64-bit | 2.6.2 | [Windows zip file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.2/msms_win64_2.6.2.zip) | extract the files from `msms_win64_2.6.2.zip` |

- **Linux:** the tar file contains two binaries. `msms.x86_64Linux2.2.6.2.staticgcc` runs on any
  64-bit x86 Linux; `msms.x86_64Linux2.2.6.2` needs glibc 2.34 or later, libtirpc and libgomp.
- **macOS:** `msms.universalDarwin.2.6.2` is one binary for Apple silicon Macs (macOS 11 or
  later) and Intel Macs (macOS 10.15 or later). If macOS refuses to run it after the download,
  run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine msms.universalDarwin.2.6.2` in the unpacked folder.
- **Windows:** keep `libomp.dll` in the same folder as `msms.exe`. It also runs on Windows on Arm,
  through x64 emulation.

### Older systems

For macOS 10.14 or earlier and for 32-bit Windows, use version 2.6.1, which does not have the
2.6.2 fixes:

| Platform | Version | File | Unpack with |
|---|---|---|---|
| macOS before 10.14 (pre-Mojave) | 2.6.1 | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_MacOSX_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_MacOSX_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| macOS 10.14 (Mojave), Intel | 2.6.1 | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_x86_64Darwin_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_x86_64Darwin_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| Windows 32-bit | 2.6.1 | [Windows zip file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_win32_2.6.1.zip) | extract the files from `msms_win32_2.6.1.zip` |

The files are on GitHub, in the
[msms-2.6.2](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/tag/msms-2.6.2) release (with
SHA-256 checksums) and the
[msms-2.6.1](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/tag/msms-2.6.1) release, which also
has the previous Linux and Apple silicon versions. See the [Documentation](documentation.qmd) for
how to run `msms`.
